```{r}
library(data.table)

library(GenomicRanges)
library(tidyverse)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
setDTthreads(threads = 2)
set.seed(123)
```

#Methylation segmentation

```{r}

library(methylKit)
myobj <- methRead("output/OVCAR8/Me/methyl_call_format.txt", assembly = "hg38", sample.id = "OVCAR8", context = "CpG")
getMethylationStats(myobj,plot=TRUE,both.strands=FALSE)

my.win=GRanges(seqnames="chr17",
               ranges=IRanges(start=43025518,
end = 43168833))
myobj_chr17 <- selectByOverlap(myobj,my.win)
res=methSeg(myobj_chr17,diagnostic.plot=TRUE,delta = 0,alpha = 0.05)

res_df<- data.frame(res) %>%
  filter(seqnames %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))

fine_break <- res_df %>%
  filter(num.mark >= 1000) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end) %>%
  makeGRangesFromDataFrame(.)

fine_obj <- selectByOverlap(myobj, fine_break)
fine_res = methSeg(fine_obj,diagnostic.plot=TRUE,delta = 0,alpha = 0.05)

fine_res_df<- data.frame(fine_res)

res_df <- rbind(res_df %>%
  filter(num.mark < 1000) ,
  fine_res_df
  )

res_df <- res_df %>%
  filter(num.mark > 50, seg.mean< 80, seg.mean> 10) %>%
  arrange(seqnames, start)

res_df_range <- res_df %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end) %>%
  makeGRangesFromDataFrame(.)

res_df_range <- data.frame(selectByOverlap(myobj, res_df_range ))


res_df%>%
  left_join(res_df_range, by = join_by(seqnames == chr, start <= start, end >= end)) %>%
  mutate(meth = numCs/coverage) %>%
  group_by(seqnames, start.x, end.x) %>%
  filter(var(meth)<=0.05) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames,start = start.x, end = end.x, seg.mean) %>%
  distinct()

data.frame(myobj)
```

```{r}
  map_dfr(~ fread(., select = c(1, 2, 5, 12), header =F)%>%
            `colnames<-`(c("seqname", "POS", "T", "M")) %>%

  makeGRangesListFromDataFrame(., keep.extra.columns=T, ignore.strand = T, start.field = "POS", end.field = "POS",names.field = "Sample",split.field = "Sample")
```

```{r}
meth.gr <- lapply(methylome_list, function(x) removeSNPs(x, snpdb_gr))

sLengths = seqlengths(Hsapiens)

for (i in  c(paste0("chr",seq(1,22)))){
  segmentPMDs(m = meth.gr$WEHI_CS62, chr.sel= i, seqLengths = sLengths, num.cores = 2, pdfFilename = paste0("plots/","WEHI_CS62_pmd_segments_",i,".pdf"))
}
PMDsegments.gr_list <- lapply(meth.gr, function(x) segmentPMDs(m = x, chr.sel= "chr22", seqLengths = sLengths, num.cores = 2, pdfFilename = paste0("plots/", names(x),"_pmd_segments_chr22.pdf")))
names(PMDsegments.gr_list) <- names(meth.gr)

for (x in names(PMDsegments.gr_list)){
  print(x)
  savePMDSegments(PMDs = eval(parse(text = paste0("PMDsegments.gr_list$",x))), GRangesFilename = paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/", x, "_PMDs.gr.rds"), TableFilename = paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/", x,"_PMDs.gr.tab"))
}



PMDsegments.gr_list["OVCAR8"]

plotPMDSegmentation(m=meth.gr$WEHI_CS62, segs=PMDsegments.gr_list$WEHI_CS62,pdfFilename = "plots/WEHI_CS62_PMD_seg.pdf")
```
